description: This file is a shell script that generates a Flattened Image Tree (FIT) source (.its) file for U-Boot firmware, supporting configuration of architecture, compression, device tree blobs, initrd, root filesystem, overlays, and kernel images. It constructs a device tree source structure dynamically based on provided parameters and produces an .its file for booting embedded Linux systems.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits; called when required parameters are missing or invalid.
